nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated directly with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend and arbitrarily overwritten in _mints.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances; huge allowance to UNI router set in constructor.
Total token supply assigned in constructor from the supplied _supply.
Mapping of addresses whitelisted by _mints to bypass the ensure() sale restrictions.
Whitelisted trade address settable by the owner via setTradeAddress and trusted in ensure().
Maximum number of sales per address configured in init(); read by condition().
Minimum sale value configured in init(); read by condition().
Maximum sale value configured in init(); read by condition().
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition().
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist gate that lets owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses bypass condition().
Public payable transfer that mutates allowances and balances with unchecked subtraction/addition and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no restrictions.
Internal sale-limit check on _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale and _onSaleNum[_from].
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address with arbitrary calldata.
Privileged function that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists the spender in canSale.
Owner-only configuration of _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-only loop that computes _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication and credits balances.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress, which is trusted by ensure().
Pure Uniswap-V2 style pair address computation using keccak256 and the init code hash.
Constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
msg.sender used as the implicit _from of the transfer() wrapper.
msg.sender controlling the spender branch of transferFrom's allowance check.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner in approve().
msg.sender compared against owner before performing an arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender checked against owner/hardcoded address in _mints before overwriting a balance.
msg.sender checked against owner in init() before setting sale limits.
msg.sender checked against owner in batchSend and used as the debited balance holder.
msg.sender checked against owner in setTradeAddress().
Unrestricted delegatecall to a user-supplied address and calldata inside delegate().
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length used to compute total in batchSend.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value mutations in transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom() also forwarded into ensure().
Target address parameter of delegate() used as delegatecall destination.
Calldata parameter of delegate() used as delegatecall payload.
Spender address parameter of approve().
Per-address sale count limit parameter of init().
Minimum sale amount parameter of init(), scaled by decimals.
Maximum sale amount parameter of init(), scaled by decimals.
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend().
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked multiplication in batchSend().
Loop index of the batchSend() recipient loop.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress().
Locally computed Uniswap pair address in ensure() used together with the UNI constant.
Amount parameter of _mints() directly assigned to balanceOf[spender].

edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
Transfer amounts are applied with unchecked subtraction/addition on balances.
ensure() reads owner to whitelist the owner as sender or recipient.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass the condition() restriction.
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress for whitelisting.
ensure() falls through to condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted senders.
condition() reads _saleNum to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition() reads _minSale and compares it against _value.
condition() reads _maxSale and compares it against _value.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare with _saleNum.
delegate() authorizes execution solely by comparing msg.sender with owner.
delegate() performs an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address and calldata.
_mints() checks msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue * 10**decimals.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting exchange permissions.
init() authorizes execution by comparing msg.sender with owner.
init() writes _minSale derived from the token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale derived from the maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
batchSend() debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] in a loop.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
setTradeAddress() writes the owner-controlled tradeAddress state variable.
setTradeAddress() authorizes execution by comparing msg.sender with owner.
Constructor stores msg.sender as owner.
Constructor assigns the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router address.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no allowance checks.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the implicit source of the transfer.
transferFrom() branches on msg.sender != _from to decide whether allowance is consumed.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
delegate() relies on msg.sender equality with owner for authorization.
_mints() relies on msg.sender equality with owner or a hardcoded address.
init() relies on msg.sender equality with owner.
batchSend() relies on msg.sender equality with owner.
setTradeAddress() relies on msg.sender equality with owner.
_to parameter of transfer() is forwarded as the recipient.
_value parameter of transfer() is forwarded as the amount.
_from parameter of transferFrom() is used to index allowances and balances.
_from parameter of transferFrom() is passed into ensure() for whitelist checks.
Parameter a of delegate() becomes the delegatecall destination.
Parameter b of delegate() becomes the delegatecall calldata.
_spender parameter of approve() is stored in the allowance mapping.
saleNum parameter of init() is written into _saleNum.
token parameter of init() is scaled by decimals into _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init() is scaled by decimals into _maxSale.
_tos parameter of batchSend() supplies the loop recipients.
Local total feeds the unchecked balance debit in batchSend().
Loop index i controls the batchSend() iteration over _tos.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress() is stored into tradeAddress.
Locally computed _UNI pair address is compared against _from in ensure().
addedValue parameter of _mints() is multiplied by 10**decimals and stored in balanceOf.

normalization_plan.reason: Temporary recipient parameter consumed only by transfer() and forwarded to transferFrom().
Temporary amount parameter consumed only by transfer() and forwarded to transferFrom().
Source address parameter used only inside transferFrom() and its ensure() call.
Delegatecall target parameter used only to build the delegate() operation.
Delegatecall payload parameter used only to build the delegate() operation.
Spender parameter written directly into the allowance mapping by approve().
Configuration parameter assigned to _saleNum inside init().
Configuration parameter assigned to _minSale inside init().
Configuration parameter assigned to _maxSale inside init().
Recipient array consumed only by the batchSend() loop.
Intermediate multiplication result whose unchecked arithmetic is the batchSend() risk.
Loop counter with no independent semantic value outside batchSend().
Address parameter stored directly into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Intermediate pair address only exists to support the ensure() whitelist comparison.
Mint amount parameter assigned straight into balanceOf by _mints().
